function.name: create_issue
function.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository. This tool allows you to create issues with titles, descriptions, labels, assignees, and milestones. Issues are used to track bugs, feature requests, and other tasks in a repository.

owner.title: Repository Owner
owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.title: Repository Name
repo.description: The name of the repository without the .git extension. The name is not case sensitive.

title.title: Issue Title
title.description: The title of the issue. This is a required field and should be a concise summary of the problem or feature request.

body.title: Issue Body
body.description: The body text of the issue. Supports GitHub Flavored Markdown for formatting, including headers, lists, code blocks, and links.

assignees.title: Assignees
assignees.description: An array of usernames to assign to this issue. Each user must have write access to the repository.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: An array of label names to associate with this issue. Labels help categorize and filter issues.

milestone.title: Milestone Number
milestone.description: The number of the milestone to associate this issue with. Use null to remove any milestone.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: An array of project board IDs to associate this issue with.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: The priority level of the issue, used for project management and triage.
